caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a man with a beard and dark hair. The figure is standing on a rectangular brown base. The man is mostly unclothed except for a green garment that is draped around his waist. His body is depicted with numerous red marks and streaks, suggesting wounds or blood, visible on his face, chest, arms, hands, torso, legs, and feet. The skin tone of the figure is a pale beige, with muscle and rib details sketched on the torso. The pose is slightly hunched and the head is tilted downward, with the right arm bent and the hand open, while the left arm hangs with the hand partially curled. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a handwritten inscription on the bottom right corner.
title: Wooden Christo, Painted (Front view)
